tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. A warm paper tone in light, deep petrol in dark; never pure white or black.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: number tiles, cards, table headers, the fact panel.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet wash: side notes, hover rows, code, chart plates in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 (light 13:1, dark 15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, meta rows, axis labels. 5.5:1 light, 8:1 dark on every surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, card borders, dividers. Never for text.

tokens.name: petrol
tokens.usage: The brand hue. Links, primary buttons, active nav, chart frame title. As text 6.4:1 on surface-0 (light), 8.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: petrol-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on petrol fills.

tokens.name: petrol-tint
tokens.usage: Petrol wash: selected filter chips, the current table sort, featured bands.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal orange. Accents and the comparison value in charts (the second series, the highlighted bar). As a fill it takes signal-ink; as text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (3.5:1 on surface-0 in light).

tokens.name: signal-deep
tokens.usage: Signal for small text in light theme (5.6:1 on surface-0) and dark theme; use when an orange word must be read, not seen.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on signal fills.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Signal wash: the note on posts written before the data releases, a highlighted table row.

tokens.name: seafoam
tokens.usage: Second data hue: the Europe series beside the world series, positive deltas.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Third data hue: the calibrated estimate beside the listed count, caution notes.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Fourth data hue and the focus of links inside tables in dark theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element; 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: cdi-blue
tokens.usage: Carbon Drawdown Initiative brand blue. Only the CDI logo and partner marks (every chart carries the logo bottom right, the footer carries it too); never a data, link or accent colour.

tokens.name: pathway-biochar
tokens.usage: Biochar in every chart, badge and pictogram. Fixed per pathway: a pathway looks the same on every page.

tokens.name: pathway-dac
tokens.usage: Direct air capture.

tokens.name: pathway-beccs
tokens.usage: Bioenergy with carbon capture (BECCS).

tokens.name: pathway-erw
tokens.usage: Enhanced rock weathering.

tokens.name: pathway-ocean
tokens.usage: Ocean carbon removal.

tokens.name: pathway-mineralization
tokens.usage: Mineralization and carbonated materials.

tokens.name: pathway-biomass-burial
tokens.usage: Biomass burial.

tokens.name: pathway-enabling
tokens.usage: Enabling technology (MRV, registries, software, equipment).

tokens.name: pathway-cross-cutting
tokens.usage: Cross-cutting CDR research without a specific pathway (policy, MRV, markets); replaces the General CDR label.

tokens.name: pathway-afforestation
tokens.usage: Afforestation. Retired from the published company set by Dirk's decision of 5 November 2026; keep the hue for the internal view only.

tokens.name: size-micro
tokens.usage: Size class micro (under 10 staff) in stacked bars and badges. The four classes step in lightness; micro is lightest in light theme.

tokens.name: size-small
tokens.usage: Size class small (10 to 49).

tokens.name: size-medium
tokens.usage: Size class medium (50 to 249).

tokens.name: size-large
tokens.usage: Size class large (250 and more).

tokens.name: size-unknown
tokens.usage: No size data.

tokens.name: tier-active
tokens.usage: Liveliness tier Active. Tier colors always come with the word; they differ in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: tier-moderate
tokens.usage: Liveliness tier Moderate.

tokens.name: tier-suspect
tokens.usage: Liveliness tier Suspect.

tokens.name: tier-dead
tokens.usage: Liveliness tier Likely Dead.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The homepage H1 and nothing else.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a page title: the page's point in one or two sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text on reading pages and data pages. Measure 65 to 80 characters.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis and the bold lead-in of a paragraph.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Side notes, footnotes, the method line under a chart.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Navigation, buttons, filter chips, form controls.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, table headers, badge text. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table cells. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; numbers right-aligned.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The number in a number tile. Tabular figures.

styles.name: number-m
styles.usage: Numbers in the fact panel and on cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart source lines, as-of dates, the text under a number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside a tile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, between meta rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Base page gutter at phone width; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, grid gaps, the dot-grid pitch of the cover.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below the number strip on the homepage.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, chart plates. The system is crisp: small radii.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The number strip container and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and tier badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that float over surface-0. They also keep a 1px line border; the shadow is support, not the edge.

layout.note: Two content widths and one aside; every page picks one.

tokens.name: width-data
tokens.usage: Content width of data pages: directory, census, top lists, data pages, history, profiles.

tokens.name: width-read
tokens.usage: Content width of reading pages: posts, CDR Week, about, how I work.

tokens.name: width-aside
tokens.usage: The right column for side notes and the fact panel; stacks under the text below 900px.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter at every width.
